panels.title: Hunts
panels.description: Hunts started in the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS hunts FROM hunt.hunts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Flaky tests found
panels.description: Findings the aggregator reported in the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS findings FROM results.findings WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Median hunt duration
panels.description: Created to last status change, finished hunts only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM updated_at - created_at)) AS seconds
FROM hunt.hunts WHERE status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED') AND $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Hunts by status
panels.description: Where hunts ended up, or are now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT status, count(*) AS hunts FROM hunt.hunts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY status

panels.title: Hunt runs by strategy
panels.description: Runs that finished with a failing test, passed, or crashed (no results: build error, timeout, OOM). Agents' experiments are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strategy,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND jsonb_array_length(coalesce(failed_tests, '[]')) > 0) AS "a test failed",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND jsonb_array_length(coalesce(failed_tests, '[]')) = 0) AS passed,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED', 'TIMED_OUT')) AS crashed
FROM hunt.runs WHERE experiment_id IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY strategy ORDER BY strategy

panels.title: Recent hunts
panels.description: Newest first. Minutes run to the last status change, so they grow while a hunt runs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT left(id::text, 8) AS hunt, left(commit_sha, 8) AS commit, status, findings,
       (budget ->> 'maxRuns')::int AS "max runs",
       round((extract(epoch FROM updated_at - created_at) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS minutes, created_at AS started
FROM hunt.hunts WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Findings
panels.description: Flaky tests with their score and the agents' outcome (empty while they work or wait).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.test_id AS test, f.score, f.failure_rate AS "failure rate", d.status AS diagnosis,
       d.snapshot ->> 'category' AS category, f.created_at AS found
FROM results.findings f LEFT JOIN results.diagnoses d ON d.finding_id = f.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(f.created_at) ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
